[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Anena Seertay''' was a member of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]], serving as the [[Marines (SpecForce)|Marine]] Regimental Commander for the Special Forces division assigned to the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]. Seertay was [[Death/Legends|killed in action]] during the [[Primtara Offensive]].
